component.name: MdCraft
component.summary: Markdown word processor with live preview, slides and templates

description.p: mdcraft is a word processor for Markdown with a familiar ribbon: write plain text and see a finished document or slide deck as you type. Diagrams, charts, equations, tables and media render offline. Start from Word-style document templates (report, proposal, letter, memo, minutes, résumé, specification, paper, newsletter) or PowerPoint-style decks, present full screen, print to PDF and export web pages.
